rationales.ref: Internal product reference, unique per colour and size variant, so it identifies the individual product.
rationales.label: Display name of the product; the CDM has no product name field.
rationales.description: Free text product description; not a controlled category, so productCategory does not fit.
rationales.note_public: Free text commercial note about finishing and packing; no matching CDM field.
rationales.fk_product_type: Dolibarr flag separating physical products (0) from services (1); ERP internal.
rationales.tosell: ERP flag marking the item as sellable; not passport data.
rationales.tobuy: ERP flag marking the item as purchasable; not passport data.
rationales.tobatch: Dolibarr setting that turns on lot or serial tracking; it holds no batch number value, so batchNumber does not apply.
rationales.barcode: 13 digit barcode values with EAN-13 structure (confirmed by fk_barcode_type = 2), which is a GTIN-13.
rationales.fk_barcode_type: Dolibarr code for the barcode symbology (2 = EAN13); describes the barcode format, not product data.
rationales.customcode: Customs tariff code; 61091000 is the HS heading for cotton T-shirts.
rationales.fk_country: In the Dolibarr product table this foreign key is the product's country of origin. It holds a numeric Dolibarr country id that must be resolved to a country name or code on conversion.
rationales.weight: Weight of the product itself (0.18 kg per tee), used with weight_units.
rationales.weight_units: Unit code for the weight column (0 = kg); needed for conversion but not a passport field.
rationales.length: Physical dimension of the item; CDM size is a garment size label, not a measurement.
rationales.width: Physical dimension of the item; CDM size is a garment size label, not a measurement.
rationales.height: Physical dimension of the item; CDM size is a garment size label, not a measurement.
rationales.price: Selling price; commercial data outside the passport scope.
rationales.tva_tx: VAT rate; accounting data outside the passport scope.
rationales.cost_price: Purchase cost; commercial data outside the passport scope.
rationales.accountancy_code_sell: General ledger account for sales; accounting data.
rationales.desiredstock: Target stock level for inventory planning; not passport data.
rationales.datec: Timestamp of when the ERP record was created, not the date the garment was produced, so productionDate does not apply.
rationales.options_composition: Fibre content of the garment (100% Cotton).
